Start: ^Anna, where have you been? I was so worried about you!
^Sorry, Mom. I just went to the abandoned building to find some useful stuff for us and then it started to collapse.
^But then a robot appeared and save me! Now, I'm safe and sound!
^Mom, meet Hope, the robot who saved me!
^Oh, a robot! That's amazing! Thank you so much, Hope!
^I have no idea. My memory is blank. My mission is to save and love humans. That's all what in my memory.
^Sounds weird! Other robots seem to have simple purposes like being human assistants or doing housework.
^They are police robots, cleaning robots, cooking robots, doctor robots and so on.
^But you are different, I see. You have a mission to save and love humans. What kind of robot are you?
^I don't know. I just want to save and love humans. That's all what in my memory.
^Anyway, thank you so much for saving Anna, it's so kind of you! You are a hero, Hope!
^You can see that, this town is just a small, temporary refuge. Things happened back home... things that forced my family and the rest of us to flee and end up here.
^It's a long story, but to put it simply, there was a war. A war that destroyed our home and made us lose everything. We had to run away to survive.
^I'm sorry to hear that. I hope you and your family can find a new home and live happily here.
^Don't worry. We will be fine, I believe!
^Why don't you take a walk around the town and meet some people? People here are nice and friendly, I'm sure you will like it here!
^Sure, I will! Thank you for your kindness, Ma'am!
^You're welcome, Hope! Take care and have fun exploring the town!
